'There is a *difference* between these routes,' she said, eyes tight. 'One brings you home.' The neon signs buzzed overhead, each flickering in its own broken rhythm. I had to choose fast.

ago:2.en: Grey Crow slid a dusty data card across the table. 'This was recorded twenty years *ago*,' he said quietly. I pressed play. My own voice came out of the speaker — calm, certain, giving orders to the very network I was now hunting. I did not remember any of it.
ago:2.cnHint: 一张二十年____录制的数据卡里，藏着令我不安的秘密。
ago:2.hook: I had been here before, and forgotten everything.
ago:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'Twenty years *ago*, you built this yourself.'

I pressed play.

sentences.cn: 我自己的声音从扬声器里传出来——平静、确定，给我现在追捕的网络下达命令。

essay:2.en: Tucked inside a library terminal on level nine, I found a short *essay* — no author, no date. It described channel seven not as a rebel tool but as a life-line for people the city had erased. Every sentence was precise, angry, and true. By the last line, my hands were shaking.

essay:2.hook: The final sentence had my case number in it.
essay:2.line: Ali said, 'Whoever wrote this *essay* knew you were coming.'

It described channel seven not as a rebel tool but as a life-line for people the city had erased.
sentences.cn: 它把第七频道描述的不是一个反抗工具，而是被城市抹去的人们的生命线。

sentences.en: Every sentence was precise, angry, and true.
sentences.cn: 每一句都很精准、很愤怒，也很真实。

sentences.en: By the last line, my hands were shaking.
sentences.cn: 到最后一行时，我的手在颤抖。

conversation:2.en: I found the chip behind a loose tile in the Channel Seven relay room. It held a single recorded *conversation* — two voices, low and careful, trading a name I was not supposed to know. I played it twice. The second time, I noticed the silence at the end was not empty. It was waiting.
conversation:2.cnHint: 我在中继室的地砖后发现一枚芯片，里面存着一段____，涉及一个禁忌的名字。
conversation:2.hook: The silence at the end was shaped like a question.
conversation:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'That *conversation* was erased from every public record — so why does it still exist?'

sentences.en: I found the chip behind a loose tile in the Channel Seven relay room.
sentences.cn: 我在第七频道中继室的一块松动瓷砖后面找到了芯片。

sentences.en: It held a single recorded *conversation* — two voices, low and careful, trading a name I was not supposed to know.
I played it twice.

self:2.en: The mirror in the abandoned Channel Seven booth showed my face, but the ID tag floating beside my reflection named someone else. I touched the glass. The tag flickered and reset to my real name. Somewhere between those two names was the *self* I had been before this job changed me.
self:2.cnHint: 废弃播报室的镜子里，浮现的身份标签让我开始怀疑自己的____。
self:2.hook: My real name felt less familiar than the fake one.
self:2.line: Ali whispered, 'Hold on to your *self* — Zero wants you to forget who you are.'

age:2.en: The data vault under Channel Seven had not been opened since the broadcast *age* of the 2040s, when open signals were still legal. Dust covered every shelf. Ali ran a finger along one case and held it up: the dust was grey, but underneath, the metal was still warm.

age:2.hook: Warm metal in a fifty-year-old vault means someone was just here.
age:2.line: Ali said, 'Nothing from that *age* should still be running — nothing.'

Dust covered every shelf.

future:2.en: The encoded map on the wall of the relay room pointed not to a place but to a time — three days from now, marked in red. Grey Crow studied it without blinking. 'Someone planned this long before we arrived,' he said. The *future* had already been written, and we were just catching up.
future:2.cnHint: 中继室墙上的密图指向的不是地点，而是三天后的____。
future:2.hook: We were already three moves behind an unseen hand.
future:2.line: Grey Crow said quietly, 'The *future* on that map is not a guess — it is a schedule.'

effect:2.en: Ali triggered the old Channel Seven broadcast antenna by accident. The signal lasted four seconds. The *effect* spread fast: every screen within two blocks lit up with the same seven-digit code, then went dark. Passersby stopped, looked up, and quickly looked away, as if they had been trained to forget.

effect:2.hook: People looked away too fast — that kind of fast is learned.
effect:2.line: Ali said, 'I did not expect that *effect* — did you teach them to ignore it?'

sentences.en: Ali triggered the old Channel Seven broadcast antenna by accident.
sentences.cn: 阿栗不小心启动了第七频道的老天线。

local:2.en: The *local* repair shop on Tide Street had been closed for a year, yet its sign flickered on at exactly midnight. I pressed my ear to the door. Inside, someone was typing — steady, unhurried, as if they had all the time in the world and knew I was listening.

local:2.line: Zero's voice came through the wall: 'The *local* grid is mine — every node, every light.'

I pressed my ear to the door.

sentences.en: Inside, someone was typing — steady, unhurried, as if they had all the time in the world and knew I was listening.
sentences.cn: 里面有人在打字——稳定，不紧不慢，仿佛他们有的是时间，而且知道我在听。

tend:2.en: Grey Crow warned me that Channel Seven signals *tend* to loop — the same fragment cycling until someone with the right key breaks the pattern. I listened for twenty minutes before I heard it: a half-second gap, always in the same place, like a door left open inside the noise.
tend:2.cnHint: 灰鸦提醒我，频道七的信号____会不断循环，直到有人用正确的密钥打断它。
tend:2.hook: A gap that repeats is not a flaw — it is an invitation.
tend:2.line: Grey Crow said, 'Signals like this *tend* to lead you exactly where someone wants you to go.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow warned me that Channel Seven signals *tend* to loop — the same fragment cycling until someone with the right key breaks the pattern.
I listened for twenty minutes before I heard it: a half-second gap, always in the same place, like a door left open inside the noise.
sentences.cn: 我听了二十分钟后才听到了——半秒钟的间隙，总是在同一个地方，就像噪音里有扇门被打开了。

term:2.en: The contract was burned into the wall in small white letters — seven lines, formal and cold. The final *term* read: 'Silence is consent.' I had been in this relay room for six minutes without transmitting a refusal. According to whoever wrote this, I had already agreed to something I had not yet read.
term:2.cnHint: 墙上刻着一份合约，最后一条____写道：沉默即同意——而我已经沉默了六分钟。

term:2.line: Zero's text appeared below the last line: 'You missed the *term* that matters most.'

sentences.cn: 按照写这个的人的逻辑，我已经同意了某件还没读完的事。

reduce:2.en: Deep inside Sub-Station 7, I found a humming black box wired to the city's broadcast grid. A counter on its screen ticked downward. Ali whispered, 'It will *reduce* the signal strength across all channels — silence every voice in Harbor City within minutes.' My hands moved before my mind caught up.

reduce:2.hook: The counter hit thirty seconds and kept falling.
reduce:2.line: 'This device will *reduce* every voice in the city to silence.'

sentences.cn: 我的双手比我的大脑反应得更快。

process:2.en: Grey Crow had left a data chip taped behind a broken vent in the old port warehouse. Its single file was a map — not of streets, but of steps. Each node was labeled: intercept, decode, transmit. 'Follow the *process*,' a recorded voice said, 'or the message dies with you.'
process:2.cnHint: 旧港仓库的通风口后，藏着一张描绘任务____的芯片。
process:2.hook: The final step on the map was simply marked: 'You.'
process:2.line: 'Follow the *process* exactly, or everything falls apart.'

able:2.en: The signal jammer filled the narrow server room with white noise. I pressed my ear to the cold wall, straining to catch Zero's transmission. For ten long seconds nothing came through. Then the noise broke — I was *able* to hear three words, low and clear, before silence swallowed them again.

able:2.hook: Those three words changed everything I thought I knew.
able:2.line: 'I was finally *able* to hear what Zero was hiding.'

drive:2.en: The encrypted note was small, printed on paper thin as skin, tucked inside a cracked street lantern on Dock Nine. It read: 'What you call duty, others call *drive* — the force that pushes a person past every warning sign.' Ali looked at me. Neither of us spoke.

face:2.line: 'Study the *face* — what you see is not what is there.'

relationship:2.line: 'Our *relationship* ended the night Channel Seven went silent,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Pinned inside the relay box was a photograph — Grey Crow and Zero, standing together, younger, almost smiling.
sentences.cn: 钉在中继盒子里的是一张照片——灰鸦和零点，站在一起，年轻些，几乎在笑。

sentences.en: I had never imagined any *relationship* between them.
The image was faded but the meaning was sharp: whatever they once shared had curdled into something cold and dangerous.
sentences.cn: 那个画面褪了色，但意思很清楚：他们曾经的关系已经变成了什么冷酷而危险的东西。

form:2.en: The message was not written in letters. It was a *form* pressed into the dust on the archive shelf — the outline of a key, deliberate and clean. Someone had been here, left this shape on purpose, and walked away knowing I would find it. I traced the edges with one finger.
form:2.cnHint: 档案室的灰尘上留着一个奇怪的____，那是一把钥匙的轮廓。
form:2.hook: The shelf behind it swung open without a sound.
form:2.line: 'This *form* is a message — someone wants you to follow,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The message was not written in letters.
sentences.cn: 信息不是用字母写的。

sentences.en: It was a *form* pressed into the dust on the archive shelf — the outline of a key, deliberate and clean.
Someone had been here, left this shape on purpose, and walked away knowing I would find it.
sentences.cn: 有人来过这里，故意留下这个形状，然后走了，知道我会找到它。

sentences.en: I traced the edges with one finger.
sentences.cn: 我用一根手指沿着边缘描过。

interest:2.en: Zero's broadcast contained a list of names — citizens flagged for showing too much *interest* in Channel Seven. My name was not on it. That should have been a relief. Instead, it felt like a trap. If Zero already knew who I was, being left off that list meant something worse was planned for me.
interest:2.cnHint: 零点的广播列出了对第七频道表现出过多____的市民名单。
interest:2.hook: Ali went pale. Her name was third from the top.
interest:2.line: 'Your *interest* in Channel Seven has already been noticed,' Zero's voice said.

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast contained a list of names — citizens flagged for showing too much *interest* in Channel Seven.
My name was not on it.
sentences.cn: 我的名字不在上面。

sentences.en: That should have been a relief.
sentences.cn: 这本来该让我松口气。

sentences.en: Instead, it felt like a trap.
sentences.cn: 反而感觉像个陷阱。

sentences.en: If Zero already knew who I was, being left off that list meant something worse was planned for me.
sentences.cn: 如果零点已经知道我是谁，把我从那份名单上删掉意味着对我还有更糟的计划。

simply:2.en: Ali handed me the decoded file and I read it twice, then a third time. The truth was not complex. Channel Seven had been shut down because one man wanted the city *simply* silent — no coded talk, no signal art, no hidden voices. Power dressed up as quiet. That was all.
simply:2.cnHint: 解码文件揭示了第七频道被封锁的原因，答案____得令人心寒。
simply:2.hook: The man's name at the bottom was someone I trusted.
simply:2.line: 'He *simply* wanted no one left who could speak in code,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali handed me the decoded file and I read it twice, then a third time.
sentences.cn: 阿栗递给我解码后的文件，我读了两遍，然后又读了一遍。

sentences.en: The truth was not complex.
sentences.cn: 真相并不复杂。

sentences.en: Channel Seven had been shut down because one man wanted the city *simply* silent — no coded talk, no signal art, no hidden voices.
Power dressed up as quiet.
sentences.cn: 权力穿上了沉默的外衣。

sentences.en: That was all.
sentences.cn: 就这样。

enable:2.en: Deep inside the old signal tower, I found a cracked data chip. Grey Crow had told me nothing about it. A faint label read: FREQ-07. Plugging it in would *enable* the dead Channel Seven broadcast — the one Zero had silenced three years ago. My hands wouldn't stop shaking.
enable:2.cnHint: 我在信号塔里发现一枚旧芯片，插入它将____第七频道重新广播。
enable:2.hook: The chip clicked in, and the walls started humming.
enable:2.line: 'This chip will *enable* the signal — if you're brave enough to use it.'

sentences.en: Deep inside the old signal tower, I found a cracked data chip.
sentences.cn: 在老信号塔的深处，我找到了一块裂开的数据芯片。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me nothing about it.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从没跟我提过它。

sentences.en: A faint label read: FREQ-07.
sentences.cn: 一个淡淡的标签写着：FREQ-07。

sentences.en: Plugging it in would *enable* the dead Channel Seven broadcast — the one Zero had silenced three years ago.
My hands wouldn't stop shaking.
sentences.cn: 我的手停不下来地发抖。

simple:2.en: The message was scratched onto a food-ration tin left on a wet bench outside the dockyard gate. No code, no cipher. Just twelve plain words. Ali leaned over my shoulder and read it twice. 'It looks too *simple*,' she said. Traps in Harbor City always wore clean faces.
simple:2.cnHint: 码头长椅上的锡罐留着一条看似____的留言，但阿里感到不安。
simple:2.hook: Under the tin, a second message was already dissolving in the rain.
simple:2.line: 'It looks too *simple* — someone wants us to stop thinking.'

sentences.en: The message was scratched onto a food-ration tin left on a wet bench outside the dockyard gate.
sentences.cn: 信息刻在一个生活配给罐上，放在船坞大门外一条湿漉漉的长凳上。

sentences.en: No code, no cipher.
sentences.cn: 没有密码，没有密文。

sentences.en: Just twelve plain words.
sentences.cn: 只有十二个白话字。

sentences.en: Ali leaned over my shoulder and read it twice.
sentences.cn: 阿栗靠在我肩膀上，读了两遍。

sentences.en: 'It looks too *simple*,' she said.
Traps in Harbor City always wore clean faces.
sentences.cn: 港城的陷阱总是装着干净的面孔。

several:2.en: The evidence room held *several* unmarked boxes stacked against the far wall. Each one was sealed with the same grey wax stamp — a crow in flight. I had counted them three times. Grey Crow said he had never been here. The wax told a different story.
several:2.cnHint: 证物室里有____个贴着灰色封印的箱子，与引路人的说法矛盾。
several:2.hook: The last box was still warm to the touch.
several:2.line: 'I found *several* sealed boxes — and your mark is on every one.'

sentences.en: The evidence room held *several* unmarked boxes stacked against the far wall.
Each one was sealed with the same grey wax stamp — a crow in flight.
sentences.cn: 每一个都用同样的灰色蜡封——一只飞翔的乌鸦。

sentences.en: I had counted them three times.
sentences.cn: 我数过三遍。

sentences.en: Grey Crow said he had never been here.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦说他从没来过这里。

sentences.en: The wax told a different story.
sentences.cn: 蜡印讲了另一个故事。

struggle:2.en: The encrypted file was almost open. Every second, the decryption counter climbed one digit. Zero's counter-program clawed back two. I watched the numbers war across my screen, a quiet *struggle* measured in milliseconds. Ali cut the room's outside link. Now it was just us and the math.
struggle:2.cnHint: 我的破译程序与零点的反制程序之间展开了一场无声的____。
struggle:2.hook: At zero seconds remaining, both counters froze at once.
struggle:2.line: 'This *struggle* in the code — it means Zero is watching us right now.'

sentences.en: The encrypted file was almost open.
sentences.cn: 加密文件快要打开了。

sentences.en: Every second, the decryption counter climbed one digit.
sentences.cn: 每一秒，解密计数器爬升一位。

sentences.en: Zero's counter-program clawed back two.
sentences.cn: 零点的反制程序抓回两位。

sentences.en: I watched the numbers war across my screen, a quiet *struggle* measured in milliseconds.
Ali cut the room's outside link.
sentences.cn: 阿栗切断了房间的外部链接。

sentences.en: Now it was just us and the math.
sentences.cn: 现在只有我们和这些数字。

decision:2.en: Grey Crow placed two data cards on the table. One held the Channel Seven source files. The other held the names of everyone who had reported the signal. 'You can only take one,' he said quietly. I stared at both for a long moment. Every *decision* here cost someone something.
decision:2.cnHint: 引路人摆出两张数据卡，我必须做出一个沉重的____。
decision:2.hook: I reached out — and Grey Crow caught my wrist.
decision:2.line: 'Whatever your *decision* is, you cannot take it back after tonight.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow placed two data cards on the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在桌子上放了两张数据卡。

sentences.en: One held the Channel Seven source files.
sentences.cn: 一张装着七号频道的源文件。

sentences.en: The other held the names of everyone who had reported the signal.
sentences.cn: 另一张装着所有举报过那个信号的人的名单。

sentences.en: 'You can only take one,' he said quietly.
sentences.cn: "你只能拿一张，"他平静地说。

sentences.en: I stared at both for a long moment.
sentences.cn: 我盯着两张卡看了很久。

sentences.en: Every *decision* here cost someone something.

kid:2.en: Tucked inside the hollow relay post was a child's paper notebook, its cover drawn over with stick figures and signal towers. A *kid* had mapped every hidden antenna in the south district — by hand, in crayon, perfectly accurate. No adult in the department had that data. I felt cold.
kid:2.cnHint: 一本____的涂鸦本里藏着南区所有隐秘天线的精准地图。
kid:2.hook: On the last page, my name was written in small, careful letters.
kid:2.line: 'A *kid* drew this map — which means someone has been using children to watch us.'

sentences.en: Tucked inside the hollow relay post was a child's paper notebook, its cover drawn over with stick figures and signal towers.
sentences.cn: 中空的中继站柱子里塞着一本儿童笔记本，封面上画满了火柴人和信号塔。

sentences.en: A *kid* had mapped every hidden antenna in the south district — by hand, in crayon, perfectly accurate.
No adult in the department had that data.
sentences.cn: 部门里没有任何成年人掌握那些数据。

sentences.en: I felt cold.
sentences.cn: 我感到一阵寒意。

ability:2.en: Zero's broadcast jammed every channel I tried. Ali rerouted through the old harbour grid. Still nothing. Then Grey Crow touched the console once, and Channel Seven opened like a door. His *ability* to move through blocked signals was something I had heard about but never believed until that moment.
ability:2.cnHint: 引路人展示出穿透封锁信号的____，令我第一次真正相信了传言。
ability:2.hook: Grey Crow pulled his hand back and said, 'Now Zero knows we are here.'
ability:2.line: 'Your *ability* to stay calm is the only thing keeping this channel alive.'

sentences.en: Zero's broadcast jammed every channel I tried.
sentences.cn: 零点的广播信号干扰了我尝试的每一个频道。

sentences.en: Ali rerouted through the old harbour grid.
sentences.cn: 阿栗通过老港口网络重新路由。

sentences.en: Still nothing.
sentences.cn: 还是一片杂音。

sentences.en: Then Grey Crow touched the console once, and Channel Seven opened like a door.
sentences.cn: 然后灰鸦的手指在控制台上轻轻一点，第七频道就像一扇门一样打开了。

sentences.en: His *ability* to move through blocked signals was something I had heard about but never believed until that moment.

task:2.en: The file listed only three words under my name: LOCATE. RETRIEVE. TRANSMIT. Such a short *task* for something that had already swallowed two investigators before me. I read it again in the blue glow of the screen. Somewhere above the city, Channel Seven was still sending its signal into the dark.
task:2.cnHint: 档案里我的代号下只写了三个动词，概括了这项危险的____。
task:2.hook: Below the three words, someone had added a fourth: SURVIVE.
task:2.line: 'Your *task* is written down — but no one ever told you the real cost.'

sentences.en: The file listed only three words under my name: LOCATE.
sentences.cn: 档案里我名字下面只写了三个词：定位。

sentences.en: RETRIEVE.
sentences.cn: 夺取。

sentences.en: TRANSMIT.
sentences.cn: 传输。

sentences.en: Such a short *task* for something that had already swallowed two investigators before me.
I read it again in the blue glow of the screen.
sentences.cn: 我在屏幕的蓝光下又读了一遍。

sentences.en: Somewhere above the city, Channel Seven was still sending its signal into the dark.
sentences.cn: 在城市上空的某处，第七频道仍在向黑暗里发送信号。

popular:2.en: The coded broadcast on Channel Seven was *popular* across every district of Harbor City. Everyone tuned in, not for music, but for the hidden signals buried beneath the static. I found a folded paper in my coat pocket. Someone had slipped it there. It read: 'The most listened-to voice is the most dangerous one.'
popular:2.cnHint: 第七频道的广播在全城广受追捧，我口袋里悄然出现了一张神秘纸条，暗示____的声音最危险。
popular:2.hook: The paper dissolved in my fingers before I could show anyone.
popular:2.line: 'The most *popular* channel,' Grey Crow said, 'is the one they most want to silence.'

sentences.en: The coded broadcast on Channel Seven was *popular* across every district of Harbor City.
Everyone tuned in, not for music, but for the hidden signals buried beneath the static.
sentences.cn: 所有人都调频收听，不是为了音乐，而是为了埋在静电下的隐藏信号。

sentences.en: I found a folded paper in my coat pocket.
sentences.cn: 我在大衣口袋里发现了一张折叠的纸。

sentences.en: Someone had slipped it there.
sentences.cn: 有人塞进去的。

sentences.en: It read: 'The most listened-to voice is the most dangerous one.'
sentences.cn: 纸上写着："听众最多的声音就是最危险的声音。"

current:2.en: I picked up a small metal disc from the wet pavement near the old signal tower. Its surface hummed with a faint *current*, like a heartbeat trapped inside cold steel. Ali had warned me about objects like this — alive with hidden data, waiting for the right hands. These were the right hands.
current:2.cnHint: 我在信号塔旁捡到一枚金属圆盘，它带有微弱的____，仿佛储存着某种秘密。
current:2.hook: The disc grew warm, and a voice began to speak.
current:2.line: 'Feel that *current*,' Ali whispered. 'Someone is already sending a signal.'

sentences.en: I picked up a small metal disc from the wet pavement near the old signal tower.
sentences.cn: 我在老信号塔附近的湿漉漉的人行道上捡起一个小金属圆盘。

sentences.en: Its surface hummed with a faint *current*, like a heartbeat trapped inside cold steel.
Ali had warned me about objects like this — alive with hidden data, waiting for the right hands.
sentences.cn: 阿栗曾警告过我这样的东西——被隐藏数据激活，等待合适的手去触碰。

sentences.en: These were the right hands.
sentences.cn: 这就是合适的手。

difficult:2.en: The message was scratched onto the underside of a rusted vent cover deep in the Channel Seven relay station. The symbols were *difficult* to read — layered, shifting, built to confuse anyone who lacked the cipher key. I had the key. Zero knew that. Which meant Zero was already close.
difficult:2.cnHint: 我在中继站找到一条刻在通风口底部的信息，上面的符号极为____，需要密钥才能读懂。
difficult:2.hook: Behind me, a vent cover scraped open in the dark.
difficult:2.line: '*Difficult* is the point,' Zero said coldly. 'Easy messages get people caught.'

sentences.en: The message was scratched onto the underside of a rusted vent cover deep in the Channel Seven relay station.
sentences.cn: 信息被刻在第七频道中继站深处一个生锈通风口的底面上。

sentences.en: The symbols were *difficult* to read — layered, shifting, built to confuse anyone who lacked the cipher key.
I had the key.
sentences.cn: 我有密钥。

sentences.en: Zero knew that.
sentences.cn: 零点知道。

sentences.en: Which meant Zero was already close.
sentences.cn: 这意味着零点已经很近了。

amount:2.en: Stacked inside the hollow base of a Channel Seven antenna was a sealed box. Inside: data chips, each holding a staggering *amount* of intercepted city-wide transmissions. Months of secrets. Years, maybe. Ali counted the chips in silence, her face pale under the neon glow filtering through the cracked ceiling above us.
amount:2.cnHint: 天线底座的暗格里藏着一个密封盒，里面存有惊人____的截获信号数据。
amount:2.hook: One chip was still warm — recorded less than an hour ago.
amount:2.line: 'The *amount* here,' Ali said quietly, 'is enough to bring down the whole network.'

sentences.en: Stacked inside the hollow base of a Channel Seven antenna was a sealed box.
sentences.cn: 第七频道天线的中空底座里堆着一个密封盒子。

sentences.en: Inside: data chips, each holding a staggering *amount* of intercepted city-wide transmissions.
Months of secrets.
sentences.cn: 数月的秘密。

sentences.en: Years, maybe.
sentences.cn: 也许是数年。

sentences.en: Ali counted the chips in silence, her face pale under the neon glow filtering through the cracked ceiling above us.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在沉默中数着芯片，她的脸在透过裂开天花板滤下来的霓虹灯光下显得苍白。

point:2.en: Grey Crow handed me a thin stylus pulled from behind a loose wall panel in the relay room. The sharp *point* at its tip was not for writing — it was a scanner, designed to read the coded graffiti sprayed along the station walls. Each tag was a node. Each node was a name.
point:2.cnHint: 灰鸦给了我一支特制探针，它的____能够扫描墙上隐藏在涂鸦中的密码节点。
point:2.hook: The last name on the wall was mine.
point:2.line: 'Touch the *point* to the tag,' Grey Crow said. 'And do not pull back.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a thin stylus pulled from behind a loose wall panel in the relay room.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦从中继室一块松动的墙板后面拔出一支细细的触笔递给我。

sentences.en: The sharp *point* at its tip was not for writing — it was a scanner, designed to read the coded graffiti sprayed along the station walls.
Each tag was a node.
sentences.cn: 每个标签都是一个节点。

sentences.en: Each node was a name.
sentences.cn: 每个节点都是一个名字。

role:2.en: Buried in the Channel Seven archive logs was a file with my name attached. I opened it with cold hands. It listed every move I had made since arriving in Harbor City. Someone had assigned me a *role* in this operation long before I ever volunteered — a part I had been playing without knowing the script.
role:2.cnHint: 我在频道七的存档记录中发现了自己的档案，原来我早已被安排了一个____，却毫不知情。
role:2.hook: The file's author was listed only as Zero.
role:2.line: 'Your *role*,' Zero's voice crackled through the static, 'was chosen before you were born.'

sentences.en: Buried in the Channel Seven archive logs was a file with my name attached.
sentences.cn: 第七频道的归档日志里埋着一份和我名字相关的文件。

sentences.en: I opened it with cold hands.
sentences.cn: 我用冰冷的手打开它。

sentences.en: It listed every move I had made since arriving in Harbor City.
sentences.cn: 里面列出了我到达港湾城以来的每一步行动。

sentences.en: Someone had assigned me a *role* in this operation long before I ever volunteered — a part I had been playing without knowing the script.

survey:2.en: The signal led me to a collapsed bridge on the edge of Sector Nine. Grey Crow handed me a scanner. 'You need to *survey* the whole underside,' he said. Rust and old paint flaked into the dark water below. Hidden among the beams, a small metal case blinked with a slow green light.
survey:2.cnHint: 在破旧的桥梁底部，我奉命____这片区域，却发现了一个神秘的金属盒子。
survey:2.hook: The case was still warm — someone had just left it.
survey:2.line: '*Survey* every beam before you touch anything,' Grey Crow warned.

sentences.en: The signal led me to a collapsed bridge on the edge of Sector Nine.
sentences.cn: 信号把我引到了九号扇区边缘一座坍塌的桥。

sentences.en: Grey Crow handed me a scanner.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦递给我一个扫描仪。

sentences.en: 'You need to *survey* the whole underside,' he said.
Rust and old paint flaked into the dark water below.
sentences.cn: 铁锈和旧漆皮纷纷扬扬地落入下方的黑暗水面。

sentences.en: Hidden among the beams, a small metal case blinked with a slow green light.
sentences.cn: 在钢梁之间隐藏着一个小金属箱，一盏绿色的灯在缓缓闪烁。

care:2.en: Ali found the message folded inside a cracked street lamp near the old port. The paper was thin, almost falling apart. 'Handle it with *care*,' she said, passing it to me with steady hands. The words on it were not in any language I knew — yet somehow, I could read every line.
care:2.cnHint: 阿栗在路灯里发现了一张纸条，叮嘱我要____地对待它，而那张纸上的文字令人费解。
care:2.hook: The last word on the note was my own name.
care:2.line: 'Take *care* — this paper is older than the city itself,' Ali said.

sentences.en: Ali found the message folded inside a cracked street lamp near the old port.
sentences.cn: 阿栗在老港口附近一盏破裂的街灯里找到了折叠起来的信息。

sentences.en: The paper was thin, almost falling apart.
sentences.cn: 纸张很薄，几乎要散开了。

sentences.en: 'Handle it with *care*,' she said, passing it to me with steady hands.
The words on it were not in any language I knew — yet somehow, I could read every line.
sentences.cn: 纸上的文字不是任何我认识的语言——但不知怎的，我能读懂每一行。

state:2.en: Grey Crow's voice came through the earpiece, thin and broken. 'What is the *state* of the device?' he asked. I looked at the small box on the table: its screen was dark, its casing cracked, but one tiny red light still pulsed. Whatever it had carried, part of it was still alive.
state:2.cnHint: 灰鸦通过耳机询问设备的____，而那个小盒子虽然破损，却仍有信号在跳动。
state:2.hook: The red light blinked once — then spelled a name.
state:2.line: 'Tell me the exact *state* of the device — nothing left out,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice came through the earpiece, thin and broken.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音从耳机里传来，又细又断断续续。

sentences.en: 'What is the *state* of the device?' he asked.
I looked at the small box on the table: its screen was dark, its casing cracked, but one tiny red light still pulsed.
sentences.cn: 我看着桌上那个小盒子：屏幕是黑的，外壳有裂纹，但一盏微小的红灯仍在跳动。

sentences.en: Whatever it had carried, part of it was still alive.
sentences.cn: 无论它曾经承载过什么，其中一部分仍然活着。

impact:2.en: The encrypted file arrived at midnight, buried inside a routine weather broadcast. Ali and I opened it together in the back room of a closed noodle shop. The data inside showed the *impact* of a deleted signal on the city's entire communication grid — whole districts had gone silent for six minutes, seven years ago.
impact:2.cnHint: 一份加密文件揭示了某次信号删除事件对全市通讯网络的____，阿栗和我都震惊了。
impact:2.hook: Six silent minutes — and twelve people had vanished that night.
impact:2.line: 'The *impact* was larger than anyone reported,' Ali said quietly.

sentences.en: The encrypted file arrived at midnight, buried inside a routine weather broadcast.
sentences.cn: 加密文件在午夜时分到了，藏在一条例行天气播报里。

sentences.en: Ali and I opened it together in the back room of a closed noodle shop.
sentences.cn: 阿栗和我在一家关门的面馆后房间里一起打开了它。

sentences.en: The data inside showed the *impact* of a deleted signal on the city's entire communication grid — whole districts had gone silent for six minutes, seven years ago.

reason:2.en: I found the old notebook under a loose floor tile in the archive room. Most pages were blank, but one line repeated across three pages: 'There is a *reason* the seventh channel was sealed.' No name, no date. Grey Crow had told me the channel was closed due to noise. He had clearly lied.
reason:2.cnHint: 档案室的笔记本里反复出现同一句话，暗示第七频道被封锁有其____，而灰鸦对我隐瞒了真相。
reason:2.hook: On the final page, someone had drawn my face.
reason:2.line: 'There is a *reason* no one goes to that channel,' Grey Crow said flatly.

sentences.en: I found the old notebook under a loose floor tile in the archive room.
sentences.cn: 我在档案室松动的地板砖下面找到了那本旧笔记本。

sentences.en: Most pages were blank, but one line repeated across three pages: 'There is a *reason* the seventh channel was sealed.'
No name, no date.
sentences.cn: 没有署名，也没有日期。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had told me the channel was closed due to noise.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦曾经告诉我，那个频道是因为噪声太大才关闭的。

sentences.en: He had clearly lied.
sentences.cn: 他显然撒了谎。

close:2.en: The signal trace ended at a small door behind the market's power station. Ali checked her scanner. 'We are *close*,' she said, her voice low. The door had no handle, only a panel of worn keys. Rain hit the metal roof above us in hard, fast drops. Inside, something was broadcasting.
close:2.cnHint: 信号追踪把我们带到了一扇隐蔽的小门前，阿栗说我们已经很____目标了，门内仍有信号在发出。
close:2.hook: The broadcast inside was using my personal access code.
close:2.line: 'We are *close* — do not make a sound,' Ali whispered.

sentences.en: The signal trace ended at a small door behind the market's power station.
sentences.cn: 信号追踪在市集电站后面的一扇小门处中断了。

sentences.en: Ali checked her scanner.
sentences.cn: 阿栗检查了她的扫描仪。

sentences.en: 'We are *close*,' she said, her voice low.
The door had no handle, only a panel of worn keys.
sentences.cn: 门上没有把手，只有一块磨损的按键面板。

sentences.en: Rain hit the metal roof above us in hard, fast drops.
sentences.cn: 雨敲打在我们上方的金属屋顶上，又急又猛。

sentences.en: Inside, something was broadcasting.
sentences.cn: 里面有什么东西在播送信号。

individual:2.en: The city registry listed nine people who had accessed the seventh channel before it was sealed. Grey Crow pulled up their files on a cracked wall screen. 'Each *individual* on this list disappeared within a month,' he said. Eight files had a red mark. The ninth file — the most recent — had no mark yet.
individual:2.cnHint: 名单上的每一个____在接触第七频道后都神秘失踪了，而第九份档案至今没有标记。
individual:2.hook: The ninth file showed a photo — it was Ali.
individual:2.line: 'Every *individual* on this list made the same mistake,' Grey Crow said.

sentences.en: The city registry listed nine people who had accessed the seventh channel before it was sealed.
sentences.cn: 城市登记档案里有九个人在第七频道被封禁前曾经接入过。

sentences.en: Grey Crow pulled up their files on a cracked wall screen.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦在一块裂纹屏幕上调出了他们的文件。

sentences.en: 'Each *individual* on this list disappeared within a month,' he said.
Eight files had a red mark.
sentences.cn: 八份文件都标着红色记号。

sentences.en: The ninth file — the most recent — had no mark yet.
sentences.cn: 第九份文件——最新的那一份——还没有记号。

area:2.en: The signal was strongest near the old water tower in the north *area* of the port district. I climbed the iron stairs alone, scanner in hand. The reading spiked at the top — something was transmitting from inside the tower's sealed upper room. The lock on the door was brand new.
area:2.cnHint: 港区北部____的信号最强，我独自爬上水塔，发现封闭房间里有东西正在发射信号，而门锁是新的。
area:2.hook: A new lock on a sealed room meant someone had just been here.
area:2.line: 'Stay in the *area* — the signal will peak again in three minutes,' Ali said.

sentences.en: The signal was strongest near the old water tower in the north *area* of the port district.
I climbed the iron stairs alone, scanner in hand.
sentences.cn: 我独自爬上铁梯，手里拿着扫描仪。

sentences.en: The reading spiked at the top — something was transmitting from inside the tower's sealed upper room.
sentences.cn: 到了顶部读数激增——有什么东西在从塔楼密封的上层房间里播送信号。

sentences.en: The lock on the door was brand new.
sentences.cn: 门上的锁是全新的。

put:2.en: The sealed box sat on the wet floor of the old signal station. Ali pointed at the lock. I *put* my ear against the metal side and heard it — a low hum, coded pulses, a message meant for no one alive. Someone had left this here on purpose. The question was when.
put:2.cnHint: 我将耳朵贴近金属箱，____到冷金属上，听见了里面隐藏的编码脉冲。
put:2.hook: The hum stopped the moment I touched the lock.
put:2.line: '*Put* your ear here — tell me what you hear.'

sentences.en: The sealed box sat on the wet floor of the old signal station.
sentences.cn: 密封的箱子躺在旧信号站的湿地板上。

sentences.en: Ali pointed at the lock.
sentences.cn: 阿栗指向了锁。

sentences.en: I *put* my ear against the metal side and heard it — a low hum, coded pulses, a message meant for no one alive.
Someone had left this here on purpose.
sentences.cn: 有人故意把这个放在这里。

sentences.en: The question was when.
sentences.cn: 问题是什么时候放的。

difference:2.en: Two copies of the same city map were pinned to the wall of Grey Crow's safe room. I stared for a long minute. Then I saw it — one small street, erased from the newer print. That single *difference* meant one route existed in the real city that the official grid refused to show. Someone had scrubbed it clean.
difference:2.cnHint: 两张地图上有一处____，那条被抹去的街道隐藏着秘密通道。
difference:2.hook: Grey Crow whispered: that street leads straight to Zero.
difference:2.line: 'The *difference* between these two maps is the only truth left.'

sentences.en: Two copies of the same city map were pinned to the wall of Grey Crow's safe room.
sentences.cn: 两份同样的城市地图钉在灰鸦安全屋的墙上。

sentences.en: I stared for a long minute.
sentences.cn: 我盯着看了很久。

sentences.en: Then I saw it — one small street, erased from the newer print.
sentences.cn: 然后我看到了——一条小街道，在新地图上被抹掉了。

sentences.en: That single *difference* meant one route existed in the real city that the official grid refused to show.
Someone had scrubbed it clean.
sentences.cn: 有人把它彻底抹去了。

lack:2.en: Ali spread the decoded files across the table. Good data on Zero's broadcast towers, solid timing logs, clean signal traces. But one thing was missing. The *lack* of any sender ID made the whole case shaky. Without a name attached to the source, we had noise, not proof. Zero had been careful.
lack:2.cnHint: 这些解码文件中____发送者身份信息，让整个案件站不稳脚。
lack:2.hook: Ali tapped one blank field and said nothing.
lack:2.line: 'This *lack* of ID is not an accident — it is a message.'

sentences.en: Ali spread the decoded files across the table.
sentences.cn: 阿栗把解码后的文件铺开在桌上。

sentences.en: Good data on Zero's broadcast towers, solid timing logs, clean signal traces.
sentences.cn: 零点广播塔的好数据，清晰的时间日志，干净的信号痕迹。

sentences.en: But one thing was missing.
sentences.cn: 但有一样东西缺少了。

sentences.en: The *lack* of any sender ID made the whole case shaky.
Without a name attached to the source, we had noise, not proof.
sentences.cn: 没有名字依附在来源上，我们只有噪音，不是证据。

sentences.en: Zero had been careful.
sentences.cn: 零点很谨慎。

case:2.en: Grey Crow slid a thin metal folder across the table. 'This *case* started three years before you joined,' she said. Inside: six burned signal towers, forty-one intercepted words, one name that kept appearing and disappearing like smoke. I was not the first investigator on this. I might not be the last.
case:2.cnHint: 灰鸦递来的案件____卷宗显示，这个调查早在我加入前就开始了。
case:2.hook: The last investigator's name had been crossed out in red.
case:2.line: 'This *case* is older than you think — and far from closed.'

sentences.en: Grey Crow slid a thin metal folder across the table.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦推过来一个薄薄的金属文件夹。

sentences.en: 'This *case* started three years before you joined,' she said.
Inside: six burned signal towers, forty-one intercepted words, one name that kept appearing and disappearing like smoke.
sentences.cn: 里面：六座被烧毁的信号塔，四十一句被拦截的话，一个不断出现和消失的名字，像烟一样。

sentences.en: I was not the first investigator on this.
sentences.cn: 我不是这个案子的第一个调查员。

sentences.en: I might not be the last.
sentences.cn: 我也许不会是最后一个。

sure:2.en: The graffiti on the tunnel wall read: CHANNEL SEVEN KNOWS. I photographed it fast and sent it to Ali. I was not *sure* whether it was a warning or an invitation — in Harbor City the two things often wore the same face. I pressed deeper into the tunnel anyway. The signal in my head was getting louder.
sure:2.cnHint: 我不____这段涂鸦是警告还是邀请，但隧道深处的信号越来越强。
sure:2.hook: At the tunnel's end, a light blinked on — once, twice, then nothing.
sure:2.line: 'Are you *sure* you want to follow that signal alone?'

sentences.en: The graffiti on the tunnel wall read: CHANNEL SEVEN KNOWS.
sentences.cn: 隧道墙上的涂鸦写着：第七频道知道。

sentences.en: I photographed it fast and sent it to Ali.
sentences.cn: 我快速拍了照，发给了阿栗。

sentences.en: I was not *sure* whether it was a warning or an invitation — in Harbor City the two things often wore the same face.
I pressed deeper into the tunnel anyway.
sentences.cn: 我更深入隧道。

sentences.en: The signal in my head was getting louder.
sentences.cn: 我脑子里的信号声越来越大。

enough:2.en: Ali had cracked four layers of Zero's encryption by midnight. She leaned back and pressed her eyes shut. 'That is *enough* for tonight,' she said, but her screen still glowed, and the fifth layer was already loading. I watched her hands move back to the keys without her seeming to notice. Some things pull you in.
enough:2.cnHint: 阿栗说今晚的解密工作已经____了，但她的双手却不由自主地继续敲击键盘。
enough:2.hook: The fifth layer opened — and inside was our names.
enough:2.line: '*Enough* rest — the fifth layer just unlocked itself.'

sentences.en: Ali had cracked four layers of Zero's encryption by midnight.
sentences.cn: 到午夜时阿栗已经破解了零点加密的四层。

sentences.en: She leaned back and pressed her eyes shut.
sentences.cn: 她靠回去，闭上了眼睛。

sentences.en: 'That is *enough* for tonight,' she said, but her screen still glowed, and the fifth layer was already loading.
I watched her hands move back to the keys without her seeming to notice.
sentences.cn: 我看着她的手在没有察觉的情况下移回键盘。

sentences.en: Some things pull you in.
sentences.cn: 有些东西会把你吸进去。

attention:2.en: Zero broadcast a false weather report at 03:00, city-wide. Everyone heard it. But it was designed to draw *attention* away from a second, smaller signal sent two seconds later on a dead channel. I caught that second signal. Grey Crow had taught me to listen for the quiet thing hiding behind the loud one.
attention:2.cnHint: 虚假广播吸引了所有人的____，而零号在两秒后发出的微弱信号才是真正的信息。
attention:2.hook: The small signal carried three words: I see you.
attention:2.line: 'Pay *attention* to what Zero does not want you to hear.'

sentences.en: Zero broadcast a false weather report at 03:00, city-wide.
sentences.cn: 零点在凌晨三点播放了一条虚假的天气预报，全城都听到了。

sentences.en: Everyone heard it.
sentences.cn: 每个人都听到了。

sentences.en: But it was designed to draw *attention* away from a second, smaller signal sent two seconds later on a dead channel.
I caught that second signal.
sentences.cn: 我截取到了那条第二信号。

sentences.en: Grey Crow had taught me to listen for the quiet thing hiding behind the loud one.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦教过我去听那些隐藏在响亮声音后面的安静的东西。

certain:2.en: I replayed the recording four times before I let myself believe it. Grey Crow's voice, no question. But *certain* words were reversed, certain pauses were wrong. It was not a real broadcast — it was a copy, rebuilt from pieces. Someone had learned how she spoke and made a weapon out of it. Ali went pale.
certain:2.cnHint: 录音中____些词语的顺序和停顿都不对，这不是灰鸦真正的声音。
certain:2.hook: Ali said: if they can fake her voice, they can fake anyone's.
certain:2.line: 'I am *certain* — that voice was built, not recorded.'

sentences.en: I replayed the recording four times before I let myself believe it.
sentences.cn: 我反复播放了四次录音，才敢相信这是真的。

sentences.en: Grey Crow's voice, no question.
sentences.cn: 灰鸦的声音，毫无疑问。

sentences.en: But *certain* words were reversed, certain pauses were wrong.
It was not a real broadcast — it was a copy, rebuilt from pieces.
sentences.cn: 这不是真实的广播——是拼凑起来的副本。

sentences.en: Someone had learned how she spoke and made a weapon out of it.
sentences.cn: 有人学会了她说话的方式，把它变成了一件武器。

sentences.en: Ali went pale.
sentences.cn: 阿栗脸色苍白。
